lines.en: label norikodorm5:
I knock on Noriko’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Noriko 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: I’ve yet to be able to spend any time alone in there with her and, if we’re ever going to get even half as close as she wants the two of us to, that’s probably something I should start doing.
lines.zh: 我还从没能和她在那里面单独待过；而如果我们真要变得像她希望的那么亲近，哪怕只有一半，那大概也是我该开始做的事。

lines.en: It’s not only beneficial to her, though, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，这也不只是对她有好处。

lines.en: I have plenty to gain from one more questionable relationship.
lines.zh: 从又一段成问题的关系里，我能得到的好处可不少。

lines.en: Especially one revolving around the sole creature in this universe that the girl responsible for resetting it hates.
lines.zh: 尤其是当这段关系围绕着的，是这个宇宙里唯一一个被那个重置了它的女孩所憎恨的生物。

lines.en: Frankly, there’s a distinct lack of logic in my decision to continue reaching out to Noriko- but is logic really a necessary trait when consequences are no more real here than they would be in a book?
lines.zh: 坦白说，我继续接近 Noriko 这个决定明显缺乏逻辑——可当这里的后果并不比书里的更真实时，逻辑真的还是必需的品格吗？

lines.en: I was placed here to do as I please.
lines.zh: 我被放在这里，是为了随心所欲。

lines.en: Which, if you’ve realized anything about me so far, is to have sex with the girls I find attractive.
lines.zh: 而如果你到现在对我有了任何了解的话，那指的就是和我觉得有吸引力的女孩做爱。

lines.en: Noriko is attractive.
lines.zh: Noriko 很有吸引力。

lines.en: Maya is attractive.
lines.zh: Maya 很有吸引力。

lines.en: I will defile both of them or die in the process.
lines.zh: 我要把她们两个都玷污，否则就死在半路上。

lines.en: Such is life.
lines.zh: 人生就是如此。

lines.en: : Noriko, are you in there?
lines.zh: : Noriko，你在里面吗？

lines.en: I can hear the volume of distorted, intentionally messy rock music being turned down from the inside.
lines.zh: 我能听见屋里那失真的、故意乱糟糟的摇滚乐被调小了音量。

lines.en: Seems like she didn’t hear me the first time I knocked.
lines.zh: 看来我第一次敲门的时候她没听见。

lines.en: : Is somebody there?
lines.zh: : 有人在外面吗？

lines.en: : Yes, someone is here. It’s me.
lines.zh: : 有，有人在这儿。是我。

lines.en: : Oh crap! You can come in, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦糟了！你可以进来了，老师！

lines.en: : Sorry to keep you waiting, I didn’t hear you at first.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你久等了，我一开始没听见。

lines.en: scene black
: It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事。别放在心上。

lines.en: scene norikowalk1
: Well of course I’m going to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 我当然会放在心上啊。

lines.en: : What if you decided to go hang out with somebody else since I didn’t answer the door right away?
lines.zh: : 万一因为我没能马上开门，你就决定去找别人玩了呢？

lines.en: : I’m usually a bit more persistent than that.
lines.zh: : 我通常比那更有耐心。

lines.en: : If I made it to three knocks, though...that’s where I start getting angry.
lines.zh: : 不过如果我敲到第三下……那就是我开始生气的时候了。

lines.en: : Hmm...I see, I see. So don’t let you get to three knocks. Got it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……原来如此，原来如此。所以不能让你敲到第三下。明白了。

lines.en: : What’s an angry Sensei like, anyway? I’m pretty sure I’ve only seen you happy, neutral, and sad.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，老师生气是什么样的？我敢说我见过的你，只有开心、平静和难过三种。

lines.en: : I can’t ever recall a time where you like, {i}really{/i} got pissed off.
lines.zh: : 我真的想不起来有哪一次你像是……{i}真的{/i}勃然大怒过。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure the only time I’ve gotten pissed off in the last several months is when one of your classmate’s little sisters kept questioning a book I was reading to her.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，这几个月里我唯一一次真的动怒，就是你某个同学的妹妹一直在质疑我给她读的一本书。

lines.en: scene norikowalk2
: What?! You never read me stories when I was little!
lines.zh: : 什么？！我小时候你可从没给我读过故事！

lines.en: : I thought time had worn you down, not made you a family man!
lines.zh: : 我还以为时间是把你磨垮了，而不是把你变成了个顾家的男人！

lines.en: : Though, this does bode well for the future of the Nakayarakawayamas.
lines.zh: : 不过，这对 Nakayarakawayama 家的未来来说倒是个好兆头。

lines.en: : Please stop using that incredibly long last name. Something about it really triggers something in my brain to just-
lines.zh: : 拜托别再用那个长得离谱的姓了。它总有种东西会触发我脑子里某个开关，让我直接——

lines.en: scene norikowalk3
: Explode?
lines.zh: : 爆炸？

lines.en: : Oh, bright idea. Is there anywhere safe the two of us could go to light stuff on fire?
lines.zh: : 哦，好主意。我们俩有什么安全的地方可以去放火烧东西吗？

lines.en: : It’s great for stress relief and might help you get some of your memories back.
lines.zh: : 那对缓解压力很有用，说不定还能帮你找回一些记忆。

lines.en: : Was I...a pyromaniac previously?
lines.zh: : 我以前……是个纵火狂吗？

lines.en: : I meant more of the “being alone with me” part.
lines.zh: : 我指的更多是「和我单独待着」那部分。

lines.en: : Aren’t we alone together now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在不就是单独待在一起吗？

lines.en: scene norikowalk4
: We’re not. Big Brother is always watching, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不算。老大哥一直在看着呢，老师。

lines.en: : Okay, so either you have a second sibling I don’t know about or that was an Orwell reference.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那要么你还有个我不知道的兄弟姐妹，要么那就是个奥威尔的梗。

lines.en: : Obviously it’s an Orwell reference. If I had a brother, I’d have made him track you down years ago and beat you up for moving without telling me.
lines.zh: : 显然是奥威尔的梗。要是我有个哥哥，我早就让他几年前就把你找出来，因为你搬家不告诉我而揍你一顿了。

lines.en: : And if that brother was younger than you?
lines.zh: : 那如果那个哥哥比你小呢？

lines.en: scene norikowalk5
: I’d...be making sure his tutor doesn’t start teaching him anything weird.
lines.zh: : 那我就会……确保他的家庭教师不会开始教他什么奇怪的东西。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. I know an implication about myself when I hear one.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我一听就知道这是在暗示我自己。

lines.en: : What sort of weird stuff did I teach you about?
lines.zh: : 我教了你些什么奇怪的东西？

lines.en: scene norikowalk6
: Nothing we wouldn’t have learned about eventually.
lines.zh: : 都是我们迟早会学到的东西。

lines.en: : Like 1984, for example. I think we were like...ten years old when you started making us read that?
lines.zh: : 比如《1984》。我想我们大概……十岁的时候，你就开始逼我们读那本了？

lines.en: : That is far too young for that piece of literature.
lines.zh: : 读那部作品，那年纪实在太小了。

lines.en: : Probably. Like, I don’t even think Maya was into stuff that complicated back then and she was just as weird as you were.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。话说回来，我觉得 Maya 那时候都没迷上那么复杂的东西，而她跟你一样古怪。

lines.en: : {i}I’m{/i} the normal one here.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}才是这里头的正常人。

lines.en: : But I guess I should be thanking you since that book was the first of many steps on my way to becoming a real freedom fighter.
lines.zh: : 不过我想我该谢谢你，因为那本书是我成为一名真正的自由战士的许多步中的第一步。

lines.en: : And how exactly are you fighting for freedom, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那你具体是怎么为自由而战的呢，Noriko？

lines.en: : The only way a girl my age can be, through expression.
lines.zh: : 用我这个年纪的女孩唯一能做到的方式——通过表达。

lines.en: : Not like I can make any sort of real change until I build up a background or profile for myself and people start taking me seriously.
lines.zh: : 在我积累出自己的背景或名气、让别人开始把我当回事之前，我也做不出什么真正的改变。

lines.en: : I just hope I’m not too burnt out by the time I get out of [high_school] to actually do something that will make a difference.
lines.zh: : 我只希望等我离开[high_school]的时候，还没有被烧得精疲力竭，好让我真的去做点能带来改变的事。

lines.en: If you ever {i}make{/i} it out of [high_school], you mean...
lines.zh: 你是说，如果你真能从[high_school]里{i}走出去{/i}的话……

lines.en: : Then...if you could change anything in the world, what would you change first?
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你能改变这世上任何一件事，你会先改变什么？

lines.en: : Our relationship status.
lines.zh: : 我们的关系状态。

lines.en: : Our relationship matters more to you than like...climate change?
lines.zh: : 我们的关系对你来说，比……气候变化还重要？

lines.en: : They both matter. But if you want to know what would make me happiest, it’s that.
lines.zh: : 两者都重要。但如果你想知道什么最能让我幸福，那就是这个。

lines.en: : I think freedom fighters are supposed to be thinking of the greater good, not themselves.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自由战士该想的是更大的善，而不是自己。

lines.en: : Aren’t you attempting to inhibit my freedom by imposing that belief on me?
lines.zh: : 你把这种信念强加给我，不正是在试图压制我的自由吗？

lines.en: : This is exactly what I’m fighting against, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这正是我在对抗的东西，老师。

lines.en: : I just can’t imagine many people will back your cause if it’s portrayed the same way outside of this dorm room.
lines.zh: : 我只是无法想象，如果出了这间宿舍，你的主张也这么表达的话，会有多少人支持你。

lines.en: : Well, I’ve still got a few years to iron out the kinks.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还有好几年可以把这些毛病捋顺。

lines.en: scene norikowalk7
: I {i}am{/i} going to do something, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}确实{/i}会去做点什么。

lines.en: : Even if it’s just changing one person’s life or like...adopting a kid or something like that.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是改变一个人的一生，或者……领养个孩子之类的。

lines.en: : It’s hard to feel like you have a purpose in the world without a tangible symbol of that purpose, you know?
lines.zh: : 没有一样能切实象征这个目标的东西，你很难觉得自己在这世上有目标，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But if you ever need some semi-constructive criticism, you know where to look.
lines.zh: : 不太懂。不过如果你哪天需要一点半建设性的批评，你知道去哪儿找。

lines.en: scene norikowalk8
: And it’s the same place I’m always looking anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正那也是我一直看着的地方……

lines.en: : Can you just like, hurry up and remember me already?
lines.zh: : 你能不能就……快点想起我来？

lines.en: : I say a lot of stuff that would be ten times cuter if you only understood the connotations.
lines.zh: : 我说了好多话，要是你能听懂其中的言外之意，它们会可爱上十倍。

lines.en: : I think that one was pretty easy to understand.
lines.zh: : 我觉得刚才那句倒是挺好懂的。

lines.en: : So you remember how I always followed you around the house and stared at you when I was three?
lines.zh: : 那你记不记得，我三岁的时候总是跟着你在屋里转，还一直盯着你看？

lines.en: : Oh. Well, okay then. I guess there was a bit of subtext to that.
lines.zh: : 哦。那好吧。看来那里面确实有点言外之意。

lines.en: : There’s subtext to everything about me. I built myself around trying to catch your eye.
lines.zh: : 关于我的一切都有言外之意。我就是为了吸引你的目光才把自己塑造成这样的。

lines.en: : But alas, I was never the favorite.
lines.zh: : 可惜，我从来都不是最受宠的那个。

lines.en: : I guess it must have been hard falling in love with someone that your sibling is-
lines.zh: : 我想，爱上一个人，而那个人又是你兄弟姐妹的——那一定很难吧。

lines.en: scene yumis2
scene norikowalk9
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : How did we get here?
lines.zh: : 我们是怎么走到这儿来的？

lines.en: scene norikowalk10
: Well...first, I told you I wanted to go for a walk since I’m still not that familiar with this area yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯……首先，我说我想去散个步，因为我对这一带还不太熟。

lines.en: : And then {i}you{/i} said something like, “I guess I still have some time to kill.”
lines.zh: : 然后{i}你{/i}说了句类似「看来我还有些时间可以打发」的话。

lines.en: : And then we opened the door and said hi to Uta who was trying to feed our dorm-bird crackers.
lines.zh: : 然后我们打开门，跟 Uta 打了招呼，她正打算拿饼干喂我们宿舍的那只鸟。

lines.en: : And then we walked for a little while and wound up here.
lines.zh: : 然后我们走了一会儿，就到了这儿。

lines.en: : I feel like I almost remembered something.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己差点就想起了什么。

lines.en: scene norikowalk11
: An important thing?! Or like a thing you had for breakfast?!
lines.zh: : 重要的事？！还是说像你早餐吃了什么那种事？！

lines.en: : Not that breakfast isn’t important, of course! It's the most important meal of the day!
lines.zh: : 当然，我不是说早餐不重要！它是一天中最重要的一餐！

lines.en: : An important thing.
lines.zh: : 一件重要的事。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : It’s just a feeling, though. And one that’s gone now anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过只是一种感觉罢了。而且现在已经没了。

lines.en: scene norikowalk12
: Mmm!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！

lines.en: : Don’t lure me in like that! You know those memories are what my character arc is based around!
lines.zh: : 别这么勾我！你知道那些记忆就是我整条角色弧线的基础！

lines.en: : The sooner you get them back, the sooner I can move onto the next phase!
lines.zh: : 你越快想起来，我就能越快进入下一阶段！

lines.en: : And that next phase is?
lines.zh: : 那下一阶段是？

lines.en: scene norikowalk13
: Showing my parents and my sister that I was {i}not{/i} crazy and that there was always something special about the two of us.
lines.zh: : 让我爸妈和我姐知道，我{i}没有{/i}疯，而且我们俩之间一直都有某种特别的东西。

lines.en: : A little hope goes a long way, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 一点希望就能走很远，老师。

lines.en: : I don’t claim to understand you or anything. There are still a million things I don’t know about you, and I’m sure you’ll find that out in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 我不敢说我理解你之类的。关于你，我还有一百万件事不知道，而我确信你很快就会发现这一点。

lines.en: : But there’s a lot more to falling in love than simply “understanding.”
lines.zh: : 但爱上一个人，远不止「理解」这么简单。

lines.en: scene norikowalk14

: Like looking at somebody and thinking, “Yeah. I’ll still want to have sex with you in twenty years,” or “I would know what to order you for dinner if you were in the bathroom when the waitress showed up.”
lines.zh: : 比如看着某个人，心里想着「嗯，二十年后我还会想和你做爱」，或者「就算服务生来的时候你在洗手间，我也知道该替你点什么」。

lines.en: : Stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 诸如此类的东西。

lines.en: : That sounds like something Ayane would say.
lines.zh: : 这话听着像是 Ayane 会说的。

lines.en: scene norikowalk15
: Ahh, yes. Ayane.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。Ayane。

lines.en: : She loves you a lot.
lines.zh: : 她很爱你。

lines.en: : I think she’s hiding something, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得她藏着什么事。

lines.en: : I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到。

lines.en: : We’re all hiding something.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人都在藏着什么。

lines.en: : Do you think I’m hiding something?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我在藏着什么吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概是。

lines.en: : It would certainly be easy to in your position.
lines.zh: : 处在你这个位置，那当然很容易。

lines.en: : You’re right. I could manipulate you all I want into thinking things that never happened {i}actually{/i} happened.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我可以随心所欲地操纵你，让你以为那些从未发生过的事{i}真的{/i}发生过。

lines.en: scene norikowalk16
: And yet, I find myself wishing every night that you’ll just come back home...
lines.zh: : 然而，我每天晚上都在许愿，盼着你干脆回家来……

lines.en: : That one day I’ll wake up and hear the doorbell ring...and then rush downstairs and pretend I’m not excited to see you...
lines.zh: : 盼着有一天我醒来，听见门铃响起……然后冲下楼，假装自己见到你并不激动……

lines.en: : And you’ll pat my head and tell me I look cute...
lines.zh: : 而你会拍拍我的头，说我看起来很可爱……

lines.en: scene norikowalk17
: And then you’ll go upstairs and finger my sister.
lines.zh: : 然后你上楼，用手指弄我姐。

lines.en: : You wish for that, too?
lines.zh: : 你也盼着那部分？

lines.en: : That part I’d be fine with leaving out. It’s the {i}first{/i} few that I want back the most.
lines.zh: : 那部分我倒是可以去掉。我最想找回来的，是{i}前面{/i}那几个。

lines.en: : Our dynamic would have drastically changed if it was the last one you wanted most.
lines.zh: : 如果你最想要的是最后那个，那我们的关系格局可就大不一样了。

lines.en: scene norikowalk18
: Well that would still be better than it is now, right?
lines.zh: : 不过那也比现在好，对吧？

lines.en: : For me or for you?
lines.zh: : 对我，还是对你？

lines.en: : For both of us.
lines.zh: : 对我们两个都是。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you felt that way about your sister.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你对你姐是这种感觉。

lines.en: : I just mean that...at least if you were with Niki, there would be some sort of...return to normalcy, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我只是说……至少如果你和 Niki 在一起，某种程度上算是……回归常态了吧，我想。

lines.en: : Even though I found “you” it’s still not the full “you.”
lines.zh: : 尽管我找到了「你」，那也依然不是完整的「你」。

lines.en: : You’ve got a whole new life now...and a whole group of girls who would kill me if it meant being able to absorb all of my happy memories with you.
lines.zh: : 你现在有了全新的生活……还有一整群女孩，只要能吸收掉我和你之间所有幸福的回忆，她们都愿意杀了我。

lines.en: : And I would kill too if it meant being able to absorb just a few of the ones they’ve made this[school] year.
lines.zh: : 而只要能吸收掉她们在这[school]年里制造出来的哪怕几个回忆，我也愿意杀人。

lines.en: : I think I get what you’re saying, but I’m not sure where you’re going with it.
lines.zh: : 我想我明白你在说什么，但我不确定你想往哪儿说。

lines.en: : What I mean is that if you were with my sister, I’d at least know where you are every night.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你和我姐在一起，我至少每天晚上都知道你在哪儿。

lines.en: : Because right now, I can't even walk down the hall without thinking, “I wonder which door he's behind?”
lines.zh: : 因为现在，我走在走廊上，都会忍不住想「他现在在哪扇门后面呢？」

lines.en: scene norikowalk19
: Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : I knew that would be something you didn’t want to hear, but I went and said it anyway.
lines.zh: : 我明知道那是你不想听的话，可我还是说出口了。

lines.en: : I just miss you. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想你。就只是这样。

lines.en: : The best thing for me is really just whatever nets me the most time with you...because I have no idea if you’ll just disappear again one day or not.
lines.zh: : 对我来说最好的事，真的就是任何能让我和你待得最久的事……因为我完全不知道，你会不会哪天就又消失了。

lines.en: : It's really unfortunate just how possible that is.
lines.zh: : 那件事的可能性居然那么大，真的很不幸。

lines.en: scene norikowalk20
: Disappearing?
lines.zh: : 消失？

lines.en: : But...why?
lines.zh: : 可是……为什么？

lines.en: : This might sound weird, but I could technically disappear at any moment whether I like it or not.
lines.zh: : 这听起来可能很怪，但严格来说，不管我愿不愿意，我随时都有可能消失。

lines.en: : But it wouldn’t be something like moving or running away from you or whatever it was that happened in the past.
lines.zh: : 但那不是什么搬家、或者从你身边逃走，也不是过去发生过的那种事。

lines.en: : You’re not actually like, a ghost or something, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真的是……幽灵之类的吧？

lines.en: : Because that would make this a lot harder to explain to my parents when we start dating.
lines.zh: : 因为等我们开始交往，那会让我很难跟我爸妈解释。

lines.en: : I just mean that the next time I disappear, there’s a chance you will too.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，下次我消失的时候，你也有可能会跟着消失。

lines.en: : And everyone, really.
lines.zh: : 说真的，所有人都会。

lines.en: : I’m not exactly sure how it works.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定它的机制。

lines.en: scene norikowalk21
: I don’t know if I’m just too [young]to follow this train of thought, but you don’t look like you’re messing with me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是我太[young]、跟不上这套思路，可你看起来不像是在耍我。

lines.en: : What’s going on? What do you mean by all of us disappearing?
lines.zh: : 到底是怎么回事？你说我们所有人都会消失，是什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m just saying that when someone fades away, the world stops existing.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，当某个人消散的时候，这个世界就不复存在了。

lines.en: : If I “disappear,” everyone else also disappears because I’m not there to perceive them anymore.
lines.zh: : 如果我「消失」了，其他人也会跟着消失，因为不再有我去感知他们了。

lines.en: : And you think that’s equivalent to them just not existing at all?
lines.zh: : 而你认为那就等于他们根本不存在了？

lines.en: : Right.
: Isn’t that like...super selfish?
lines.zh: : 那不是……超级自私吗？

lines.en: : Like, wouldn’t you care about what happened to me if you just vanished again? How I’d process all of that?
lines.zh: : 比如说，如果你又那么凭空消失了，你就不在乎我会怎么样吗？不在乎我要怎么消化这一切吗？

lines.en: : I know enough about you already to assume that you’d just start looking again.
lines.zh: : 我已经足够了解你了，可以断定你会重新开始找我。

lines.en: : Well...yeah. Probably. But I wouldn’t be happy about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。大概是吧。但我不会开心的。

lines.en: : What about Ami or Ayane, though? Or Maya?
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 或者 Ayane 呢？还有 Maya？

lines.en: : Ami and Ayane would take it the worst.
lines.zh: : Ami 和 Ayane 会受打击最大。

lines.en: : Maya would throw a party.
lines.zh: : Maya 会开派对庆祝。

lines.en: scene norikowalk22
: Huh.
: Guess a lot can happen in just a few years.
lines.zh: : 看来短短几年里，真的能发生很多事。

lines.en: : Again, though, I think it would be closer to them all just disappearing as well.
lines.zh: : 不过再说一次，我觉得那更接近于她们也全都消失。

lines.en: : One goes out, another comes in.
lines.zh: : 一个熄灭，另一个亮起。

lines.en: : Think of it like starting a brand new world with a brand new version of you and a brand new version of me.
lines.zh: : 你可以把它想成，开启一个全新的世界，里面有一个全新版本的你，和一个全新版本的我。

lines.en: : No one disappears. They just get recycled.
lines.zh: : 没有人消失。他们只是被回收再利用了。

lines.en: scene norikowalk23
: Okay, I’m lost.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我听晕了。

lines.en: : I’m normally good with these sorts of topics and stuff, but what you’re describing sounds like something out of an anime.
lines.zh: : 我平时对这类话题挺在行的，可你描述的这些东西听起来像是动画里才有的。

lines.en: : Or at least some religion I’ve never heard of before.
lines.zh: : 或者至少是某种我从没听说过的宗教。

lines.en: Given her ties to the past, I was hoping these words would have had some sort of impact on Noriko.
lines.zh: 考虑到她与过去的牵连，我本来希望这些话能对 Noriko 产生某种触动。

lines.en: Like maybe, by some strange twist of fate, she’d acknowledge the possibility of the world resetting and memories being wiped.
lines.zh: 比如，也许借着某种奇异的命运转折，她会承认这个世界会被重置、记忆会被抹去的可能性。

lines.en: But I guess I’m still not great at explaining things I don’t understand.
lines.zh: 但我想，我依然不擅长解释那些我自己都不懂的东西。

lines.en: And it’s not like I’ve been gaining any useful information from Maya lately either, especially in her current state.
lines.zh: 而且最近我也没从 Maya 那里得到任何有用的信息，尤其是在她现在这种状态下。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: Back into the unknown then, I guess.
lines.zh: 那就再次走进未知吧，我想。

lines.en: : I’ll just make things simple by saying...don’t worry about me disappearing again.
lines.zh: : 我就把事情说简单点吧……别担心我会再次消失。

lines.en: : I can’t say any more than that, but you seem naive enough to trust me on this.
lines.zh: : 我只能说到这里，不过你看起来足够单纯，应该会相信我。

lines.en: scene norikowalk24
: I don’t have to be {i}naive{/i} to trust you, Sensei. I can just {i}trust{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 我不需要{i}单纯{/i}才去相信你，老师。我可以只是{i}相信{/i}你。

lines.en: : If you want, sure. I just can’t imagine why you ever would.
lines.zh: : 随你便。我只是想不出你为什么会那么做。

lines.en: : I’m not the same person-
lines.zh: : 我已经不是同一个人了——

lines.en: : You are.
lines.zh: : 你是。

lines.en: : Now get back to giving me a tour of the area so I’m able to find an ATM without getting lost in the future.
lines.zh: : 现在继续带我逛这一带吧，好让我以后能找到 ATM 而不至于迷路。

lines.en: scene black
Everything is casual from that point on.
lines.zh: 从那之后，一切都变得随意起来。

lines.en: There are no further discussions on spirituality and the domino effect that would come with someone’s memory being wiped.
lines.zh: 再也没有关于灵性、以及某人记忆被抹去所引发的多米诺效应的讨论。

lines.en: Just ATMs, streetlights, and the soft hand of a peculiar girl.
lines.zh: 只剩下 ATM、路灯，还有一个古怪女孩柔软的手。
